explanation: Implemented all six B03 edits. Mapped source now has an explicit workspace-panel boundary, ordered range resolution, stale-snippet suppression, worker/cache ownership, and lightweight binding reads. Connection focus navigates endpoints without changing edges. Repository review adds reverse mapping navigation, explicit reveals, search integration, and retained scroll state. Existing attachments remain intact, and edited diagrams fit their reserved bounds. D-source leaves space for later additions; shared panels and treemaps remain future work.
